skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Given two fractions with the same denominator, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole number parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of two mixed numbers (or a whole number and a mixed number).

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: When fraction subtraction yields a negative result, decrease the whole part by 1 and add the denominator to the numerator before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Rewrite whole as mixed
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction part (e.g., 3 = 3 + 0/d) to enable fraction subtraction.
